description: Post-country-first-AOR-mode and reviewer-hierarchy structural ceiling for Insight Hub 2 after browser-CI, dead-code hardening, React 19 state-map compatibility, OSHA database-persistence hardening, discovery-first occupational work, isolated official-source webviews, and the native reviewer intelligence transplant. The active application keeps one shell, three global CSS layers, reviewed page-level style blocks, lazy-loaded workspaces, and protected Hub 2 intelligence ownership routes. Injuries & Medical Conditions restores the Reviewer holographic injury-anatomy experience through a dedicated 24,000-point Three.js human-mesh projection while keeping Insight Hub 2 styling. Job Intelligence, Drug Checker, Clinical Calculators, and Standards Intelligence use a shared hierarchy-first visual system: primary action, dominant hero/result, supporting evidence, then interpretation/source boundaries. Drug Checker uses the real PubChem compound structure as the molecular hero with a dedicated transparent-canvas renderer and Insight Hub 2 aurora teal/cyan/blue/violet treatment. AOR Factors uses one MapTiler SDK vector-tile map with explicit Country and AOR selection modes. Country mode is the default and does not force a combatant command; AOR mode exposes command-wide geography and feeds. The AOR basemap now uses MapTiler Bright Dark vector tiles rather than allowing command tint layers to dominate the map appearance. Country selection/search synchronizes State travel advisories, CDC Travelers' Health vaccine/medicine guidance and destination-listed infectious-disease context, WHO outbreak intelligence, GDACS hazards, USGS seismic activity, CrisisWatch conflict context, and environmental/human-performance factors. AOR mode shows command-wide WHO/GDACS/USGS intelligence. WHO Disease Outbreak News is fetched from the current WHO endpoint without unsupported query parameters and filtered locally. Country-level WHO, GDACS, and USGS displays never substitute unrelated command-wide events when the selected country has no match. CDC travel-health content is source-attributed and explicitly presented as general destination guidance rather than individualized medical advice or a disease-prevalence ranking. Duplicate files, generated artifacts, invalid coordinates, extra app shells, new unreachable frontend files, additional architecture candidates, and additional injected-style files remain prohibited unless this baseline is deliberately reviewed and updated. Job Intelligence now deliberately adds one Neon persistence service, one dedicated profile API route, and one browser acceptance test to replace the former global localStorage duty bucket with durable company/job profiles; the reviewed repository file ceiling is therefore 270 while all duplicate, generated-artifact, reachability, shell, CSS, coordinate, and architecture-candidate ceilings remain unchanged. AOR operational-priority hardening deliberately adds two focused frontend modules: a versioned command assignment registry and a source-defined priority brief. The AOR page now starts with a global WHO/GDACS/USGS watch view, uses country bounding boxes for USGS country-mode seismic queries, and suppresses unrelated CrisisWatch fallback items; the reviewed repository file ceiling is therefore 272 while every other structural guard remains unchanged.
